A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the efficacy of smoking-cessations videos is mediated by the connectivity between visual-auditory cortices.
audiovisual integration is a key mechanism for the effectiveness of smoking cessation interventions, but only in smokers with lower levels of sensation seeking.
smoking-cessation interventions are more effective among individuals who have low sensation seeking and are exposed to smoking-cessation ads with a high AS.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the efficacy of smoking-cessations ads may depend on the characteristics of the target population.
the effectiveness of smoking interventions can be improved by tailoring them to individuals’ sensation-seeking level.
smoking-cessation video ads should not be developed and tested without considering the level of audiovisual integration in the videos and the level of sensation seeking in the target population.
